Russia claims Europe bought $320 billion in hydrocarbons since 2022

Russia claims Europe has purchased hydrocarbons worth $320 billion since the beginning of 2022. Russian Energy Minister Novak stated that oil exports from Russia may return to pre-war levels by the end of the current year.
